title: Universal Music Publishing, Classy's two companies and the spelling of Leclerc
summary: Cookie was published by Universal; Leclerc thinks Classy changed Triangle to Universal. His name is misspelled Leclerc on the sheet.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
